title: Checkout fails with clear notification when cart contains a soft-deleted product (Bad Case)
preconditions: User has added product {{deletedProductId}} to cart, then Admin soft-deleted {{deletedProductId}} via DELETE /api/v1/products/{{deletedProductId}}

assertions: detail contains 'has been removed and is no longer available. Please remove it from your cart before checking out.'
Order is not created and remaining items stay in cart
